full_prompt_en: A square fantastical painted illustration shows a young adult with blue-toned hair and skin looking upward into a dense field of flowers, leaves, and curling shapes. The figure occupies the lower-left half and is shown from the waist upward in a loose pale shirt. One hand rests against the chin, while the head tilts back and the eyes follow something beyond the upper edge. Deep teal shadows describe the neck and cheek beneath a much paler blue highlight on the forehead and nose. The shirt is folded in broad cream and cool gray planes, with fine blue contour lines gathering around the sleeves and collar. Behind and above the figure, pale blossoms, pale blue leaves, and small coral-red petals interlock until the background becomes an almost continuous ornament. Dark navy stems and pockets of shadow wind through this growth, giving the pale details enough separation to remain readable. Toward the upper center, winglike and petal-like forms spread outward in a loose radiant motion, but no single object dominates them. The boundary between the figure and surroundings alternates between clear outline and shared blue hatching, making the body feel immersed in the decorative environment. Soft, cool light seems to enter from the upper right, catching the upturned face and white shirt while deeper teal remains under the jaw and in the foliage. Fine lines, translucent layers, and small rough marks keep the painted surface lively. The overall composition uses the upward gaze and rising ornamental currents to create a dreamy, richly woven sense of movement.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形幻想性绘画插图描绘一名有蓝色调头发与皮肤的年轻成年人，仰望由花朵、叶片和卷曲形状构成的密集世界。人物占据左下半部，以腰部以上形象出现，穿宽松浅色衬衫。一只手靠在下巴上，头向后仰，眼睛追随上方画边之外的事物。深青绿阴影描绘颈部与脸颊，额头和鼻梁则有更浅的蓝色亮部。衬衫由大块奶油色和冷灰平面折成，细蓝轮廓线聚在袖子与衣领周围。人物身后与上方，浅色花朵、淡蓝叶片和珊瑚红小花瓣互相咬合，使背景几乎成为连续装饰。深海军蓝花茎和阴影空隙穿行其中，让浅色细节仍能彼此区分。上方中央附近，似翅与似花瓣的形态向外铺开，形成松散放射动势，却没有单一物件主导。人物与周围环境的边界在清楚轮廓与共享的蓝色排线之间交替，使身体仿佛浸在装饰环境里。柔冷光似从右上方进入，照亮仰起的面容和白衬衫，下颌及叶丛中则保留较深青绿。细线、透明层次和小型粗糙笔画使绘画表面活跃。整体构图利用向上目光和升起的装饰性流线，营造梦幻而编织繁密的动势。
style_prompt_en: The image has a fantastical painterly-illustration finish in which delicate linework and layered color weave focal forms into dense ornament. Teal, slate blue, cream, pale gray, and small coral-red accents create a cool field energized by warm sparks. Fine hatching describes volume and texture, while broader translucent planes keep larger shapes legible. Edges alternate between sharp contour and gradual dissolution into nearby marks, giving the space a floating, interlocked quality. Curling lines and repeated small motifs radiate around a calmer focal area rather than forming rigid perspective. Soft cool light picks out raised planes, and dark navy pockets separate overlapping layers. The surface remains matte, slightly rough, and visibly worked. The overall effect is intricate, lyrical, and gently kinetic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有幻想性绘画插图质感，细腻线条和层叠色彩把焦点形态编织进密集装饰中。青绿、石板蓝、奶油色、浅灰及少量珊瑚红强调构成被暖色火花激活的冷色域。细密排线描绘体积与肌理，较宽的透明平面让大形状仍清楚可读。边缘在尖锐轮廓与逐渐消融入邻近笔画之间交替，使空间仿佛漂浮且互相咬合。卷曲线和重复的小图案围绕较平静的焦点区域放射，而非形成僵硬透视。柔冷光挑出凸起平面，深海军蓝空隙分隔重叠层次。表面保持哑光、略粗糙且有明显加工痕迹。整体效果繁复、抒情而轻轻流动。
theme_en: A blue-toned figure looking up into a dense floral world
theme_zh: 蓝调人物仰望繁密花卉世界
name: James Jean
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
